name: Jog 800m + progressive strides
coaching_cue: Finish each stride slightly faster, last near 80%

name: Skipping series
coaching_cue: Regular, arm swing, for height, for distance

name: Lateral leg swings
coaching_cue: Hips stay square while the leg opens and closes

name: Walking knee hugs
coaching_cue: Rise onto the toe of the stance leg

name: Walking quad pulls
coaching_cue: Heel to glute, reach tall with the opposite arm

name: Walking lunges with twist
coaching_cue: Front knee tracks over the ankle; rotate over the front leg

name: Inchworms
coaching_cue: Legs straight to load the hamstrings

name: A-skips
coaching_cue: Dorsiflexed toe, paw down under the hip: down, not out

name: B-skips
coaching_cue: Extend out, then paw back down under the hip

name: Butt kicks
coaching_cue: Heels to glutes, knees pointing down, quick turnover

name: Straight-leg bounds
coaching_cue: Strike the ground under the hips, legs straight

name: Karaoke (grapevine)
coaching_cue: Opens the hips for curve running

name: Hip circles
coaching_cue: Knee at 90 degrees, big controlled circle

name: Ankle dribbles
coaching_cue: Short quick steps on the balls of the feet

name: 90/90 Hip Switches
coaching_cue: Hips square, sit tall — rotate, don't lean
